judgment.rationale: Service-mode startup and pairing failure needs phase-specific tracing. Hypothesis: service-mode initialization or pairing policy prevents usable connections; no-socket and rejected-pairing cases may be distinct. This is an initial investigation direction, not a runtime-confirmed diagnosis.
evidence: Reporter supplies SYSTEM/normal log comparisons and a normal-mode control on 0.102.3101/0.102.2933.
New independent reply reproduces 0.102.3101; listeners occasionally exist but pairing still fails, and switching to an unconnected machine loses usable input.
Service Stopped with exit code 0 is consistent with its launch-and-exit worker and is not proof of launch failure.
